name: PERSOL
h1: A mid-term plan built on AI, tracked in one place
lede: PERSOL's Mid-term Management Plan to FY2028 puts AI at the centre of business model change across its SBUs. Airtable gives each initiative, owner and return target one connected view.
why_h2: Plans, investment and results moving together
why_p: A multi-SBU plan with a sized AI investment and quarterly results by SBU needs operating data that is already connected.

signals.title: JPY 19 billion AI investment
signals.body: At its mid-term plan briefing PERSOL sized AI investment at JPY 19.0 billion over FY2026 to FY2028, against expected returns of JPY 33.0 to 43.0 billion.
signals.angle: Track AI initiatives against their return targets in a connected base, not a deck.
signals.src: PERSOL Holdings mid-term plan briefing, 14 May 2026

signals.title: IR Day 2026: SBU and technology strategies
signals.body: PERSOL briefed investors on SBU and technology strategies under the FY2028 plan, including a solution-driven Technology SBU targeting 10 percent revenue CAGR.
signals.angle: Give multi-SBU plans one view of initiatives, owners and progress.
signals.src: PERSOL Holdings IR Day 2026 materials, 6 Jul 2026

signals.title: FY2026 Q1 results by SBU
signals.body: PERSOL reported first quarter results by SBU and reinforced its AI strategy.
signals.angle: Quarterly SBU reporting is faster when operating data is already connected.
